g03.goal: Reduce my electricity bill by 20% but my family still needs hot water.
g03.answer:

Plan to save 33.01 kWh / 23.1 PEN / 20.2%:

- cut standby tv
- reduce water heater by 14 min/day, keeping hot water

This meets your 20% goal with least intrusion. Approve to apply?
